open_questions: A chmod or chown bumps inodes.version, so a content write based on the old version becomes a conflicted copy. That is safe but may create unnecessary copies. Should content writes compare a separate content version? This needs agreement with the sync spec before W9.
Should the examiner's clean bring-up seed 10k inodes (enough for DB-05) or 100k (the rubric's exemplary level)? Decide after S8 measures seed time on the lab machine, against a 60-second target.
The §11.4 hash index on blobs(sha256) is kept alongside the required unique B-tree. Does the instructor accept 'kept and measured' if the hash index turns out no faster?
The Week-2 lab machine spec decides shared_buffers and work_mem. Every pilot figure, including this spec's verification run on a developer laptop, must be re-measured on it.
Bulk operations are atomic: one unreadable entry fails a whole cp -r, where GNU would copy the rest. Do the examiners accept this difference?

Fault injection is armed only on the local/examiner compose profile, never on production (C7). Does the instructor agree that the examiner's clean clone of the tagged release counts as 'the tagged release' for the live demo?
Is a 24-hour recovery point (nightly pg_dump) acceptable for the production database this semester, or should WAL archiving be added?
The verification ran on the bookworm -pg18 image. The trixie-variant digest still has to be recorded in THIRD_PARTY.md and the verification repeated on it in Week 5.
The team must disclose in AI_USAGE.md that the schema was validated by an AI-assisted run, and must re-create the harness scripts themselves in db/ and tests/.
